question: Is a ready FP32 ONNX encoder available for a controlled quantization-only comparison with the exact pinned GigaAM v3 E2E RNNT INT8 export?
scope: Read-only local provenance and official upstream metadata/source research. No weights downloaded, export/inference performed, or model/config changed.

result.reason: Pinned maintainer repository contains only encoder.int8.onnx. Official export creates the floating encoder, quantizes it and removes that floating file. Checked maintainer listings/release metadata expose no separate FP32 v3 punctuation RNNT encoder.

pinned_conversion.match_scope: Publisher LFS SHA256 and sizes for decoder/joiner match local model-lock provenance; small tokens.txt content hash independently rechecked. No FP32 sibling is present, so a full matched FP32/INT8 pair is not established.

source_observations: Loads v3_e2e_rnnt, writes tokenizer IDs and encoder/decoder/joint ONNX outputs.
Adds sherpa metadata to the floating encoder, then quantize_dynamic produces encoder.int8.onnx.
Renames decoder and joint to decoder.onnx/joiner.onnx; os.remove deletes v3_e2e_rnnt_encoder.onnx.
official_exporter.wrapper_scope: Historical wrapper installs GigaAM from main rather than a pinned author-code commit, so rerunning it now is not automatically a controlled quantization-only comparison.

release_metadata.scope: Release metadata only; archive was not downloaded. It is not evidence of an available matched FP32 encoder.

author_checkpoint_alternative.scope: Author PyTorch checkpoint, not a ready FP32 ONNX encoder; equality of its parameters to the historical maintainer export has not been established.

checkpoint_provenance_gap.interpretation: Different checkpoint file hashes may reflect serialization or parameter changes. Neither is established here; a fresh main export cannot simply be called the FP32 counterpart of the pinned INT8 export.

controlled_ab_requirements: Pin and obtain the exact author checkpoint and export-source/dependency versions.
Export in an isolated environment while retaining the pre-quantization ONNX encoder.
Verify decoder/joiner/token identity or tensor-level equivalence to the current pack; independently verify encoder provenance.
Record newly generated FP32 size/SHA and measure dev improvement before evaluating the selected candidate on holdout.
not_established: No exact published FP32 ONNX URL/size/SHA.
No FP32 compatibility, WER, RTF or memory measurement.
No claim that the author PyTorch checkpoint is numerically identical to the pinned ONNX export.
